01 · The list

Every word,
in exam order

HSK 5 adds 1,298 new words, for a cumulative syllabus of about 2,500. Newspapers, films and a full speech become readable and followable. Every entry shows the hanzi, pinyin with tone marks and an English meaning.

In Lock&Learn Chinese this list is the HSK 5 pack: a word waits in hanzi with its pinyin; one tap reveals the meaning and a real sentence. HSK 5 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Type to filter by hanzi, pinyin or meaning. Flashcards hides the meaning until you tap a row; Shuffle deals the list in a new order.

02 · Sample sentences

25 words,
each in a sentence

Every word in Lock&Learn Chinese comes with a real example sentence, its reading and a translation, revealed on the tap. Here are 25 from this list.

保持

bǎochí

keep or maintain

为了保持健康，他每天坚持跑步和健身。

Wèile bǎochí jiànkāng, tā měitiān jiānchí pǎobù hé jiànshēn.

To maintain good health, he insists on running and working out every day.

便

biàn

convenient / while at it (in 'shùnbiàn')

你顺便帮我买一瓶水吧。

Nǐ shùnbiàn bāng wǒ mǎi yī píng shuǐ ba.

Please pick up a bottle of water for me while you are at it.

操心

cāoxīn

worry about

为了准备这次考试，父母一直为我操心。

Wèile zhǔnbèi zhè cì kǎoshì, fùmǔ yīzhí wèi wǒ cāoxīn.

My parents have been constantly worrying about me to help me prepare for this exam.

单纯

dānchún

simple and pure

他一直保持着单纯的性格，非常容易相信别人。

Tā yīzhí bǎochí zhe dānchún de xìnggé, fēicháng róngyì xiāngxìn biérén.

He has kept a pure and simple character, making him very gullible.

导演

dǎoyǎn

film director or direct

这次电影节的最佳导演由一位年轻的电影人获得。

Zhè cì diànyǐngjié de zuìjiā dǎoyǎn yóu yī wèi niánqīng de diànyǐngrén huòdé.

The best director award at this film festival went to a young filmmaker.

发挥

fāhuī

to display innate ability

他在舞台上完全发挥出了自己的真实水平。

Tā zài wǔtái shàng wánquán fāhuī chūle zìjǐ de zhēnshí shuǐpíng.

He fully displayed his true ability on stage.

改正

gǎizhèng

to correct errors

他虚心地接受了大家的建议，并认真改正了自己的错误。

Tā xūxīn de jiēshòu le dàjiā de jiànyì, bìng rènzhēn gǎizhèng le zìjǐ de cuòwù.

He humbly accepted everyone's advice and earnestly corrected his errors.

光荣

guāngróng

honorable or glorious

作为一个医生，能为病人服务是我的光荣。

Zuòwéi yīshēng, néng wèi bìngrén fúwù shì wǒ de guāngróng.

As a doctor, it is an honor for me to serve patients.

规模

guīmó

scale or scope

这家公司的业务规模在不断扩大。

Zhè jiā gōngsī de yèwù guīmó zài bùduàn kuòdà.

The scale of this company's business is constantly expanding.

胡说

húshuō

to talk nonsense

你别在那儿胡说了，我根本没有说过那种话。

Nǐ bié zài nàr húshuō le, wǒ gēnběn méiyǒu shuōguò nèizhǒng huà.

Stop talking nonsense, I never said anything like that.

华裔

Huáyì

ethnic Chinese person

他是华裔，从小就会说中文。

Tā shì Huáyì, cóngxiǎo jiù huì shuō Zhōngwén.

He is ethnic Chinese, so he has been able to speak Chinese since he was young.

滑冰

huábīng

to ice skate

冬天到了，我们一起去公园滑冰吧。

Dōngtiān dàole, wǒmen yīqǐ qù gōngyuán huábīng ba.

Winter is here, let's go ice skating at the park together.

健身房

jiànshēnfáng

fitness center gym

我每天下班以后都会去健身房锻炼一个小时。

Wǒ měitiān xiàbān yǐhòu dūhuì qù jiànshēnfáng duànliàn yī gè xiǎoshí.

I go to the gym to work out for an hour every day after getting off work.

克服

kèfú

overcome or conquer difficulties

我们要共同努力，克服一切困难。

Wǒmen yào gòngtóng nǔlì, kèfú yīqiè kùnnán.

We must work together to overcome all difficulties.

流传

liúchuán

spread or circulate

这个民间故事已经在当地流传了好几百年。

Zhè ge mínjiān gùshi yǐjīng zài dāngdì liúchuán le hǎo jǐ bǎinián.

This folktale has been circulating locally for several hundred years.

浓

nóng

strong or dense

这杯咖啡太浓了，我有点喝不惯。

Zhè bēi kāfēi tài nóng le, wǒ yǒudiǎn hē bù guàn.

This cup of coffee is too strong, I am not used to drinking it.

配合

pèihé

to cooperate with

我们必须和相关部门密切配合，完成这项任务。

Wǒmen bìxū hé xiāngguān bùmén mìqiè pèihé, wánchéng zhè xiàng rènwù.

We must cooperate closely with the relevant departments to complete this task.

热爱

rè'ài

to love ardently/dearly

他热爱音乐，而且非常有天赋。

Tā rè'ài yīnyuè, érqiě fēicháng yǒu tiānfù.

He loves music dearly and is very gifted.

人生

rénshēng

one's life

人生如梦，我们要珍惜时间。

Rénshēng rú mèng, wǒmen yào zhēnxī shíjiān.

Life is like a dream; we must cherish time.

田野

tiányě

field or open land

秋天的时候，我喜欢去田野里散步。

Qiūtiān de shíhòu, wǒ xǐhuān qù tiányě lǐ sànbù.

I like to go for a walk in the fields during the autumn.

危害

wēihài

jeopardize or harm

长期吸烟会危害你的身体健康。

Chángqī xīyān huì wēihài nǐ de shēntǐ jiànkāng.

Long-term smoking will harm your physical health.

现金

xiànjīn

cash money

我没带信用卡，只好付现金。

Wǒ méi dài xìnyòngkǎ, zhǐhǎo fù xiànjīn.

I didn't bring my credit card, so I had to pay cash.

小气

xiǎoqì

stingy or petty

你别这么小气，请大家喝杯咖啡吧。

Nǐ bié zhème xiǎoqì, qǐng dàjiā hē bēi kāfēi ba.

Don't be so stingy, treat everyone to a coffee.

娱乐

yúlè

entertainment and recreation

为了丰富业余生活，周末我们经常参加一些娱乐活动。

Wèile fēngfù yèyú shēnghuó, zhōumò wǒmen jīngcháng cānjiā yīxiē yúlè huódòng.

To enrich our spare time, we often participate in entertainment and recreational activities on weekends.

证件

zhèngjiàn

identity documents

请出示您的有效证件，以便我们进行登记。

Qǐng chūshì nín de yǒuxiào zhèngjiàn, yǐbiàn wǒmen jìnxíng dēngjì.

Please show your valid identity documents so that we can register you.

04 · Questions

Asked and
answered

How many words are in the HSK 5 vocabulary list?

1,298. The six-level HSK syllabus adds about 150, 150, 300, 600, 1,300 and 2,500 new words per level, about 5,000 in all; this page lists the words that are new at HSK 5, not the cumulative total.

Is this the official HSK HSK 5 word list?

It follows the official six-level HSK syllabus (HSK 2.0), the list the HSK 1 to 6 exams are still administered on. The HSK 3.0 standard published in 2021 reorganises vocabulary into nine bands and is not what this page shows.

How do I study the HSK 5 list on my iPhone Lock Screen?

Install Lock&Learn Chinese, then touch and hold your Lock Screen, tap Customize, tap the widget area and choose Lock&Learn Chinese. The HSK 5 pack puts these words on the widget one at a time: you recall the meaning, one tap reveals it with a real sentence. HSK 5 opens with a free preview and another word unlocks daily; Lock&Learn+ opens every pack at once.

Can I download the HSK 5 vocabulary list as a PDF?

Yes. Use your browser's Print or Save as PDF: the page has a print layout that keeps only the heading and the full table, every word on this list.

Is Lock&Learn Chinese free?

Yes. The app is free on iOS: HSK 1 is free, every other pack opens with a free preview, and another word unlocks daily. Lock&Learn+ is an optional upgrade that opens every pack at once, offered as a yearly plan or a one-time lifetime purchase.
